audit.why: Four spikes, correct: your 2-3 zone, your 4-5 grenade window, your Level 6 UPGRADE!!! answer to The Equalizer, his 2-item AP reclaim. 'Your favor is front-loaded, so cash it' is the right instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns told you to 'bait Scrap Shield, then commit' with no number — and Scrap Shield is a 6-second cooldown, so waiting it out is not a plan. Nothing anywhere used Rumble's Heat mechanic, which is the actual punish window.
audit.why: At 100% Heat he Overheats and cannot cast spells at all. That, not a 6s shield, is the window where a dashless Heimerdinger gets to commit for free. The Equalizer is 130s at rank 1 and Electro Harpoon carries 2 charges at 850 range, which is how he chips you without ever entering the nest.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names The Equalizer's 130s, Scrap Shield's 6s with the explicit 'you cannot outwait it', and Overheat as the free window; dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d carry the same correction.

audit.why: The Equalizer creates a wall of flames that cuts retreat, and you have no dash — the flagged missing interaction is that Flash should be held for the wall, not for the damage.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Rumble contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret and no grenade against a walk-up Flamespitter — concede the first contact and last-hit from range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Scrap Shield's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your strongest stretch: bank the center-stun and any walk-in to Flamespitter is stunned inside three beams and deleted.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Scrap Shield's cooldown.
edits.after: Your first AP item owns the siege — force fights while The Equalizer's 130s is running.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Scrap Shield and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. Favoured — the lane is decided by punishing his Overheat and dodging Electro Harpoon.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Rumble carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Rumble carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - The Equalizer: 130s at rank 1 — the wall of fire, not the damage, is what kills you. - Scrap Shield: 6s, so you cannot outwait it. - Overheat: at 100% Heat he cannot cast at all — that is your window.

edits.before: Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 6s — you cannot outwait it, so punish the Overheat.

edits.before: Rumble wastes Scrap Shield — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: At 100% Heat he cannot cast at all — that is the free window.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The Equalizer walls off your retreat — hold Flash for the wall.
